title: Akku.scm 1.2.0 released - weinholt.se
excerpt: Akku.scm version 1.2.0, the language package manager for R6RS and R7RS Scheme, is now generally available. It can be downloaded from GitLab. The most important change is a fix to the dependency solver, which was running very slowly due to a bug triggered by the many versions of the chez-srfi package.
content_html:
Akku.scm version 1.2.0, the language package manager for R6RS and R7RS Scheme, is now generally available. It can be downloaded from GitLab. The most important change is a fix to the dependency solver, which was running very slowly due to a bug triggered by the many versions of the chez-srfi package.

Akku is a project-based package manager, where each project has its own set of dependencies. You use .akku/env to set shell variables that let your Scheme implementation know where to find everything.

You can upload your own packages to the archive. They go through a review process to ensure nothing malicious is distributed.

Akku also performs automatic conversion from the R7RS define-library form to the R6RS library form. This lets, e.g., Chez Scheme use R7RS libraries. Packages from the Snow package manager, which has many R7RS packages, are also available via Akku.

Further reading

  • The Akku website
  • The Akku package list
